summary: billing-service crashed and restarted repeatedly after a deploy introduced an unhandled exception in the invoice calculation path for a rare discount code combination.
root_cause: A deploy shipped invoice calculation logic that threw an unhandled exception when two specific discount codes were combined, which happened rarely but consistently crashed the worker process handling that order.
fix: Rolled back the deploy, added exception handling around discount combination logic, and added a regression test for that discount pair.
